sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of atacicept during breastfeeding. Because atacicept is a large protein molecule with a molecular weight of 73,500 Da, the amount in milk is likely to be very low. It is also likely to be partially destroyed in the infant’s gastrointestinal tract and absorption by the infant is probably minimal. Waiting for at least 2 weeks postpartum to resume therapy may minimize transfer to the infant.
